findings.title: A back or next arrow drawn pointing the wrong way
findings.message: This back arrow points left in right-to-left. It should point right.
findings.fix: In right to left, draw the arrow the other way, mirror it with a :dir(rtl) { transform: scaleX(-1) } rule, or swap the glyph, such as ← for →.
findings.snippet: <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M15

findings.title: A direction icon that points the wrong way
findings.message: "الشهر_previous" is not mirrored in right-to-left. Check it points the way the reader moves.
findings.fix: Mirror it in RTL with a :dir(rtl) { transform: scaleX(-1) } rule, or swap to the opposite icon.
findings.snippet: <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9

findings.title: No Arabic font in the stack
findings.message: "Noto Arabic" is named but never loaded.
findings.fix: Load an Arabic family with @font-face or a font link and name it in the stack, for example "IBM Plex Sans Arabic".
